journeys.title: Prospective member on a phone (375px) wants to attend this Friday's meeting
steps: Open https://www.sastamps.org/ on a 375px viewport; scroll to Upcoming Meetings.
Identify the next Friday (e.g. Oct 2 2026, BOG; Show & Tell) and the times (doors 6:30, meeting 7:30).
Tap "View Individual Meeting Downloads", try to add just that meeting to the phone calendar.
Fall back to "Download Complete Q4 2026 Schedule"; import it on iOS and Android.
Open the map on meetings.html, start directions to 2903 Nacogdoches Rd, Building 1.
Go to Membership, open the application PDF on the phone.
journeys.expected: The calendar shows the right Friday at the right local time; directions reach the church; the PDF opens and its payment instructions are current. Expect failure at step 3 (H-06/M-08/M-15).

journeys.title: Someone contacting the club (desktop 1440, then phone, then JS off)
steps: Open contact.html, fill name, email, phone, topic, a 50-character message; submit.
Repeat on a 375px phone and again with JavaScript disabled (native POST, #sent notice).
Repeat on Slow 3G (C-07).
Check the recipient inbox and reply to each message.
Also send a plain email to loz33@hotmail.com from the footer link.
journeys.expected: Every submission arrives once with all fields and the sender as reply-to; the reply reaches the sender; a club officer (not only the webmaster) learns of each message; the mailbox answers.

journeys.title: Current member checks the next auction and plans to attend
steps: Open meetings.html; find the Oct 16 2026 auction in the schedule list.
Click RSVP, reload, un-RSVP, reload (M-06).
Click Set Reminder (M-07).
In the calendar, navigate to October 2026 and click the 16th (M-10, M-11); close the modal with Escape.
Add the auction to a calendar.
journeys.expected: Member can see auction rules/times and add it to a calendar; RSVP/reminder behaviour is recorded against the known issue (no one at the club is told; reminder click throws).

journeys.title: Newsletter reader wants the newest PHILATEX and to subscribe

journeys.expected: The PDF is Q4 2026; the summaries match; the reader learns how to receive future issues (expect failure: no #subscribe target); the editor replies.
